products.name: Intermodal Transportation Services
products.description: Provides nationwide door-to-door intermodal freight transportation by combining rail and local trucking, using company-owned containers and tractors as well as contracted third parties. Service includes long-haul rail, local drayage, and shipment tracking technology.

products.name: Dedicated Trucking Services
products.description: Offers dedicated fleets of equipment and drivers to customers on a contract basis for local and regional trucking, using company-owned and contracted assets, tailored to customer-specific needs.

products.name: Transportation Management Services
products.description: Provides non-asset-based management of customers’ transportation needs, including shipment optimization, mode selection, carrier management, load planning, and execution, leveraging proprietary technology and third-party carriers.

products.name: Freight Brokerage Services
products.description: Arranges third-party trucking transportation for customers, including dry van, expedited, less-than-truckload (LTL), refrigerated, and flatbed services, by contracting with a network of carriers.

products.name: Consolidation and Fulfillment Services
products.description: Provides warehousing, cross-docking, shipment consolidation, and order fulfillment services, including e-commerce fulfillment, using a network of company-operated and third-party facilities across North America.

products.name: Final Mile Delivery and Installation Services
products.description: Delivers and installs appliances and big and bulky goods to residential customers, operating through a network of independent service providers and facilities throughout the continental United States.

products.name: Petroleum Refined Products
products.description: Production and sale of gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, and distillates through physical refining of crude oil at two refineries, distributed via pipeline, rail, and truck to retailers, railroads, farm cooperatives, and other marketers.

products.name: Renewable Diesel
products.description: Production and sale of renewable diesel from renewable feedstocks such as soybean oil and corn oil, using a converted hydrocracker unit, with product delivered primarily via rail under offtake agreements.

products.name: Nitrogen Fertilizer Products
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of nitrogen fertilizer products, primarily ammonia and urea ammonium nitrate (UAN), using pet coke gasification and natural gas as feedstocks at two production facilities, sold to agricultural and industrial customers via rail, truck, and barge.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to businesses, including commercial real estate, business term loans, lines of credit, and participation in syndicated loans. These are delivered through in-person relationship banking and centralized underwriting, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending and Mortgage Banking
products.description: Origination and sale of one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, including both fixed and adjustable-rate products, with a significant portion sold into the secondary market. Involves in-person and digital origination, underwriting, and compliance with agency and government guidelines.

products.name: Construction, Land and Land Development Lending
products.description: Provision of loans for residential and commercial construction, land acquisition, and land development, primarily to builders, developers, and qualified owner-occupants. Requires specialized underwriting, monitoring, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multifamily properties, including affordable housing projects, with both fixed and adjustable-rate options. Delivered through specialized underwriting and appraisal processes.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Loans to agricultural businesses for operating expenses, equipment purchases, and real estate, secured by crops, livestock, equipment, or farmland. Requires in-depth knowledge of agricultural cycles and collateral management.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans such as home equity lines of credit, auto, boat, and recreational vehicle loans, and credit cards, primarily to existing clients. Delivered through branches and digital channels, with centralized underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a broad range of deposit accounts, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, and retirement accounts, to individuals, businesses, and public sector entities. Delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provision of treasury management solutions such as cash management, remote deposit capture, and retail repurchase agreements, primarily to business clients. Delivered via digital platforms and in-person support, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Loan Servicing
products.description: Servicing of loans for institutional owners, including processing payments, managing escrow accounts, and collecting taxes and insurance. Involves both in-house and digital servicing infrastructure, generating fee income.

products.name: Asphalt Production Plants and Equipment
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, and markets complete lines of asphalt plants (batch and drum mix), cold central plant recycle systems, soil remediation plants, and major plant components. These are large, physical manufacturing products delivered and installed at customer sites, often customized for specific project needs.

products.name: Concrete Production Plants and Equipment
products.description: Manufactures stationary and portable concrete batch plants, bagging plants, paste back-fill plants, concrete mixers, and major plant components. These are physical manufacturing products, often customized and delivered for on-site installation and operation.

products.name: Heating and Combustion Systems
products.description: Produces fuel and liquid asphalt storage tanks, liquid asphalt terminals, thermal fluid heaters, polymer plants, heat recovery units, and industrial/asphalt burners and systems. These are manufactured physical systems for industrial heating and combustion applications, including retrofit and alternative fuel options.

products.name: Road Construction and Forestry Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures asphalt pavers, material transfer vehicles, milling machines, wood chippers and grinders, blower trucks and trailers. These are large, physical machines used in road building, land clearing, and forestry applications, delivered to contractors and operators.

products.name: Industrial Automation Controls and Telematics Platforms
products.description: Develops and sells industrial automation controls and telematics platforms (e.g., Signal platform) for equipment monitoring, production control, and remote diagnostics. These are digital and electronic systems integrated into physical equipment or sold as standalone solutions.

products.name: Environmental Control Systems
products.description: Manufactures emissions-control devices such as dust collectors, charcoal fume scrubbers, blue smoke systems, and moisture control systems for industrial and road construction applications. These are physical systems designed to reduce environmental impact and ensure regulatory compliance.

products.name: Aggregate and Minerals Processing Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures heavy equipment for crushing (jaw, cone, impact crushers), screening (incline, horizontal, high frequency screens), washing (washing/classifying plants), and material handling (conveyors, feeders, loaders) used in mining, quarrying, recycling, and bulk handling. These are large, physical machines delivered to industrial customers.

products.name: Rock Breaking and Demolition Equipment
products.description: Produces rock breaker systems, hydraulic breakers, compactors, and pulverizers for aggregate, mining, construction, and demolition applications. These are physical machines and attachments used to break and process oversized material.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Service
products.description: Manufactures and sells replacement and OEM parts for all equipment lines, including parts for some competitors' equipment, and provides installation, maintenance, and technical support services. This is a recurring, integral business line supporting equipment uptime and customer operations.

products.name: Targeted Oncology Therapeutics (including Antibody-Drug Conjugates and Radioligand Therapies)
products.description: A portfolio of targeted oncology therapeutics, primarily antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and radioligand therapies (RLTs), designed, developed, and manufactured using proprietary antibodies, linkers, and payloads. These therapeutics are delivered as injectable or oral drugs for the treatment of various solid tumors and hematologic malignancies, and require advanced biomanufacturing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Varegacestat (Gamma Secretase Inhibitor for Desmoid Tumors)
products.description: An investigational, oral, once-daily gamma secretase inhibitor (GSI) therapy for the treatment of desmoid tumors, produced via small molecule synthesis and delivered as an oral medication. Commercialization is subject to regulatory approval and requires pharmaceutical manufacturing and distribution capabilities.

products.name: IM-1021 (ROR1 Antibody-Drug Conjugate for B-cell Lymphoma and Solid Tumors)
products.description: A receptor tyrosine kinase-like orphan receptor 1 (ROR1) targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) incorporating a proprietary TOP1 inhibitor payload, developed for the treatment of B-cell lymphomas and select solid tumors. Manufactured using biotechnological processes and delivered as an injectable therapy.

products.name: IM-3050 (FAP-Targeted Radioligand Therapy for Solid Tumors)
products.description: A fibroblast activation protein (FAP)-targeted lutetium-177 radioligand therapy (RLT) for the treatment of solid tumors, designed to deliver radioactive isotopes directly to tumor-associated fibroblasts. Requires radiopharmaceutical manufacturing and specialized distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Novel Solid Tumor Antibody-Drug Conjugates (IM-1617, IM-1340, IM-1335)
products.description: A pipeline of preclinical, first-in-class antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) targeting novel or underexplored receptors in a range of solid tumors, including colorectal, lung, breast, ovarian, neuroendocrine, pancreatic, and prostate cancers. These biologic drugs are manufactured using proprietary antibodies, linkers, and payloads, and are delivered as injectable therapies.

products.name: Mobility and Barcode Solutions
products.description: Distribution of automatic identification and data capture (AIDC) technology, including mobile computing devices, barcode scanners, imagers, RFID devices, barcode printers, and related services. These are physical hardware products sourced from suppliers and delivered through wholesale/resale channels.

products.name: Point-of-Sale (POS) Solutions
products.description: Provision of POS systems and integrated software platforms, including computer-based terminals, tablets, monitors, payment processing solutions, receipt printers, and related peripherals. These are physical and digital products distributed to channel partners for retail, grocery, and hospitality environments.

products.name: Payment Terminals and Services
products.description: Distribution of payment terminals, self-service kiosks, mobile payment devices, and related services such as key injection, encryption, and hardware support. These are physical devices and associated services provided to merchants and channel partners.

products.name: Physical Security Solutions
products.description: Distribution of electronic physical security products, including video surveillance, analytics, video management software, access control, and intrusion-related products. These are hardware and software solutions requiring specialized deployment and training.

products.name: Networking Solutions
products.description: Distribution of networking infrastructure products such as switches, routers, wireless products, and networking software. These are physical and digital products that form the backbone of IT and communications solutions for end users.

products.name: Communications Solutions
products.description: Provision of communications solutions, including voice, video, unified communications, contact center solutions, and integration of communication platforms. Delivered as hardware, software, or cloud-based services, these solutions support business communications needs.

products.name: Connectivity and Cloud Services
products.description: Distribution of business communications services, managed connectivity, wireless enablement, cloud services, and SaaS offerings. These are digital and subscription-based services provided through contracts with telecom carriers and cloud providers.

products.name: Technology Advisory and Consulting Services
products.description: Provision of technology advisory, consulting, and professional services to channel partners and end users, including telecom expense management and solution design. These are human-delivered services focused on optimizing technology investments and deployments.

products.name: Managed IT Services
products.description: Provision of outsourced IT services, including management of infrastructure, networks, security, and cloud environments for end users. These services are delivered by managed service providers (MSPs) and include proactive monitoring, maintenance, and support.

products.name: Retail Fuel Sales
products.description: Sale of gasoline and diesel fuel to customers at self-service pumps at nearly all store locations, requiring regulated infrastructure and fuel distribution logistics.

products.name: Prepared Food and Dispensed Beverages
products.description: Freshly prepared foods (notably pizza, sandwiches, bakery items) and dispensed beverages made in-store kitchens and sold at the counter, requiring in-person labor and foodservice operations.

products.name: Packaged Grocery and General Merchandise
products.description: Retail sale of packaged foods, snacks, beverages, tobacco, frozen foods, health and beauty aids, automotive products, and other non-food items, sourced from manufacturers and distributed via company-operated centers.

products.name: Alcoholic Beverage Sales
products.description: Sale of beer, wine, and spirits at store locations, requiring compliance with age-restricted product regulations and licensing.

products.name: Tobacco and Nicotine Product Sales
products.description: Sale of tobacco and nicotine products at retail locations, requiring regulatory compliance and special sales licenses.

products.name: Car Wash Services
products.description: Provision of automated car wash services at select store locations, requiring physical infrastructure and maintenance.

products.name: Lottery, ATM, and Prepaid Card Services
products.description: Provision of in-store services including lottery/lotto ticket sales, ATM access, and prepaid card sales, delivered via partnerships and in-store terminals.

products.name: Wholesale Fuel Supply
products.description: Wholesale distribution of fuel to dealer sites and other wholesale locations not operated by Casey's, involving fuel terminal operations and supply agreements.

products.name: Automotive Electronic and Electro-Mechanical Devices
products.description: Custom-designed and manufactured electronic and electro-mechanical products for automotive OEMs, including overhead and center consoles, ergonomic switches, transmission lead-frames, insert molded components, LED-based lighting, and sensors. Production involves advanced engineering, physical manufacturing, and integration of sensing and lighting technologies.

products.name: Industrial Power and Lighting Solutions
products.description: Manufactured exterior and interior lighting systems, industrial safety radio remote controls, flexible cables, laminated busbars, custom power assemblies, and high-current/high-voltage cabling for industrial, aerospace, commercial vehicle, data center, military, and telecommunications markets. Delivery requires physical manufacturing, electrical engineering, and compliance with industrial standards.

products.name: High-Speed Digital Communication and Interface Solutions
products.description: Engineered high-speed digital communication products over copper media, such as copper transceivers, distribution point units, and solid-state touch panels for data center, broadband, and appliance markets. These are developed through advanced electronics design and are delivered as physical components for integration into customer systems.

products.name: Medical Surface Support Technology (Discontinued)
products.description: Surface support technology aimed at pressure injury prevention, previously sold under the Dabir Surfaces brand. Involves specialized medical device manufacturing and was delivered as physical products to healthcare providers. This business line was discontinued and assets sold in fiscal 2024.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides a full range of commercial banking services including accepting and holding deposits, making loans, and offering ATM, drive-in, night deposit, remote deposit capture, internet and mobile banking, payroll cards, funds transfer, and other customary banking services. Delivered through a network of physical banking centers and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person human labor.

products.name: Mortgage Lending
products.description: Offers mortgage loan products through dedicated mortgage loan offices, involving origination, underwriting, and servicing of residential mortgage loans. Delivered via specialized offices and requires regulatory compliance and financial capital.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Provides trust and wealth management services including personal trust administration, estate administration, oil and gas management, farm and ranch management, property management, testamentary trusts, revocable and irrevocable trusts, agency accounts, and administration of retirement and employee benefit accounts. Delivered through a regulated trust company with specialized staff and physical offices.

products.name: Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Offers insurance products and services through a dedicated insurance agency subsidiary, acting as an agent for various insurance lines. Delivered via licensed agents and requires regulatory compliance.

products.name: Securities Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides securities brokerage services through arrangements with third-party firms, enabling customers to buy and sell securities. Delivered via partnerships with external brokerage firms and requires regulatory oversight.

products.name: Whole Genome Sequencing and Genomic Testing Services
products.description: Direct-to-consumer and institutional whole genome sequencing and related genomic testing services, delivered via online platforms and CLIA-certified labs, providing ancestry, health, and personalized reports. Requires regulated laboratory infrastructure and digital report delivery.

products.name: Personal Genomics Data Analysis and Subscription Services
products.description: Digital platform services allowing consumers to upload existing DNA data for expanded analysis and receive ongoing health and ancestry insights via subscription, leveraging proprietary databases and bioinformatics tools.

products.name: Novel Therapeutic Drug Development (Linebacker Platform)
products.description: Development and commercialization of proprietary small molecule drugs (LB-1 and LB-2) targeting cancer, inflammatory, and memory-related diseases, involving preclinical and clinical research, regulatory approval, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

products.name: Dietary Supplements (TK Supplements® Brand)
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and marketing of branded herbal and nutritional supplements for health, energy, and sexual vitality, distributed through major retail and online channels. Requires sourcing, formulation, and compliance with dietary supplement regulations.

products.name: Clinical Diagnostic Testing Services (COVID-19 and Respiratory Pathogens)
products.description: Provision of clinical laboratory diagnostic testing services, including PCR and rapid antigen tests for COVID-19 and Influenza, performed in CLIA-certified labs. Involves regulated laboratory operations and sample processing.

products.name: Esophageal Pre-Cancer Diagnostic Screening Test (BE-Smart Test)
products.description: Development and planned commercialization of a laboratory-developed test (LDT) for early detection of esophageal cancer risk, utilizing tissue samples and proteomic analysis. Requires clinical validation and regulatory compliance as a medical device.

products.name: Precious Metal Stream Interests
products.description: Acquisition and management of metal stream agreements, which provide the right to purchase a portion of metals (primarily gold and silver) produced from mines in exchange for upfront payments. This is a financial product delivered through contractual agreements, not physical mining or delivery.

products.name: Mining Royalty Interests
products.description: Acquisition and management of royalty interests in mining projects, providing the right to receive a percentage of revenue or metals produced from mining operations after specified costs. This is a financial product delivered through legal agreements, not physical mining or delivery.

products.name: Knowledge Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based, AI-powered software that enables organizations to capture, organize, and distribute information for internal knowledge sharing, customer self-service, and contact center operations. Delivered digitally via a multi-tenant SaaS platform, requiring no on-premise installation.

products.name: Content Lifecycle and Workflow Automation Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software products that automate document management, compliance, and process workflows, including content capture, storage, retrieval, automated processing, and secure digital faxing. Delivered as SaaS, supporting digital transformation and regulatory compliance across industries.

products.name: Project and Portfolio Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based applications that assist organizations in planning, governance, and operational oversight of projects and portfolios. Delivered digitally, these tools support resource allocation and project tracking for enterprise customers.

products.name: Customer Reference Management Solutions
products.description: Software applications that help enterprises manage and leverage customer references for sales and marketing purposes. Delivered as part of the cloud-based portfolio, enabling digital management of customer advocacy programs.

products.name: IT Spending Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based tools that enable organizations to track, manage, and optimize IT expenditures. Delivered digitally, supporting financial governance and cost control for enterprise IT departments.

products.name: Professional Services for Software Implementation and Integration
products.description: Fee-based consulting, implementation, integration, and configuration services provided to customers to ensure successful deployment and adoption of Upland’s software products. Delivered by in-person or remote expert teams, tailored to customer needs.

products.name: Premier Success Plans and Customer Support Services
products.description: Bundled service offerings providing enhanced technical support, training, and customer success management, including 24/7/365 support, health checks, and business reviews. Delivered digitally and via dedicated support teams to maximize customer value and retention.

products.name: Korlym and Authorized Generic (mifepristone)
products.description: Orally administered medication for the treatment of hypercortisolism (Cushing’s syndrome), manufactured as tablets and distributed via specialty pharmacies to physicians and patients in the United States.

products.name: Selective Cortisol Modulators for Hypercortisolism (e.g., relacorilant)
products.description: Proprietary, orally administered selective cortisol modulators (such as relacorilant) developed for the treatment of hypercortisolism, produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing and delivered as tablets, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Selective Cortisol Modulators for Oncology (e.g., relacorilant, nenocorilant)
products.description: Proprietary selective cortisol modulators (such as relacorilant and nenocorilant) developed for use in combination with chemotherapy or immunotherapy for the treatment of solid tumors, including ovarian, endometrial, cervical, pancreatic, and prostate cancers; delivered as oral medications, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Selective Cortisol Modulators for Metabolic Diseases (e.g., miricorilant)
products.description: Proprietary selective cortisol modulators (such as miricorilant) developed for the treatment of metabolic diseases, specifically metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH); administered orally and produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing, currently in clinical trials.

products.name: Selective Cortisol Modulators for Neurologic Disorders (e.g., dazucorilant for ALS)
products.description: Proprietary selective cortisol modulators (such as dazucorilant) developed for the treatment of neurologic disorders, specifically amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS); administered orally and produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing, currently in clinical trials.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of natural gas from owned reserves in the Appalachian Basin, utilizing large-scale, multi-pad drilling and hydraulic fracturing. Production is delivered via pipeline to utilities, marketers, industrial customers, and for LNG export.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction, processing, and sale of NGLs (including ethane, propane, isobutane, normal butane, and natural gasoline) recovered from natural gas production, marketed to utilities, industrial customers, and other buyers.

products.name: Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction and sale of oil produced as a byproduct from natural gas wells, delivered to market via established channels.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering Services
products.description: Provision of gathering services for natural gas via a proprietary pipeline network and compression infrastructure, transporting gas from wellheads to processing or transmission facilities. Services are provided to both internal and third-party producers.

products.name: Natural Gas Transmission and Storage Services
products.description: Provision of interstate natural gas transmission and storage services through a regulated pipeline and storage network, including long-term, firm capacity contracts with utilities, producers, and marketers. Includes equity interests in joint venture pipelines.

products.name: Gold Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction of gold from company-owned underground and open pit mines in Nevada, processed through internal or third-party facilities, and sold into global markets. Production involves physical mining, mineral processing, and compliance with environmental regulations.

products.name: Silver Production and Sales
products.description: Extraction of silver as a byproduct from gold mining operations in Nevada, processed through internal or third-party facilities, and sold into global markets. Production requires physical mining, mineral processing, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Plant-Based High-Protein Instant Ramen Meals
products.description: Ready-to-eat, shelf-stable instant ramen meals featuring 20 grams of complete plant-based protein per serving, produced in advanced U.S.-based manufacturing facilities and distributed through retail, foodservice, and e-commerce channels. These meals are available under brands such as Chef Woo, Chef Ramsay, Ramen Express, and Woodles, and are certified kosher, halal, vegan, and vegetarian.

products.name: Whole Grain-Rich Ramen Noodles for Institutional Programs
products.description: Whole grain-rich ramen noodles designed to meet nutritional guidelines for school meal programs, made with at least 51% whole wheat flour and high protein content, produced in the company's U.S. facility and distributed primarily to schools and institutional buyers under the Woodles brand.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Provides deposit accounts, personal loans, and related financial services to individual customers through physical branches and digital channels. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure, in-person service, and digital platforms.

products.name: Business Banking Services
products.description: Offers deposit accounts, treasury management, and financial solutions tailored to small and medium-sized businesses, community organizations, and public entities, delivered via branches and digital platforms.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: Provides a variety of loans including real estate, commercial, agricultural, and consumer loans to individuals and businesses, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Mortgage Origination and Loan Servicing
products.description: Originates and services residential mortgage loans for homebuyers and homeowners, involving both in-person and digital processes and ongoing loan management.

products.name: Seniors Housing and Wellness Housing Leasing
products.description: Leasing of seniors housing and wellness housing properties, including independent living, assisted living, continuing care retirement communities, Alzheimer's/dementia care, and care homes with or without nursing, to external customers. Properties are physically constructed, owned or controlled by Welltower, and delivered through rental agreements or master leases, often with management by third-party operators.

products.name: Long-Term/Post-Acute Care Facility Leasing
products.description: Leasing of long-term and post-acute care facilities, primarily skilled nursing and rehabilitation centers, to external operators under triple-net leases. These facilities require physical infrastructure, are regulated, and provide 24-hour nursing and medical care, often reimbursed by government programs.

products.name: Outpatient Medical Building Leasing
products.description: Leasing of outpatient medical buildings to healthcare providers, including health systems and physician groups. Properties are physically constructed and leased under various expense pass-through structures, often located on or near hospital campuses.

products.name: Real Estate Loans and Construction Financing
products.description: Provision of real estate loans and construction financing to third parties for the acquisition, development, and construction of healthcare and seniors housing properties. These are financial products, typically secured by real estate, and generate interest income.

products.name: Investments in Unconsolidated Real Estate Entities
products.description: Equity investments in unconsolidated entities, such as joint ventures and private funds, that own healthcare and seniors housing real estate. Welltower earns returns through equity participation rather than direct property ownership or leasing.

products.name: Venture Lending (Venture Loans)
products.description: Provision of secured debt financing, primarily senior term loans, to development-stage companies in technology, life science, healthcare information and services, and sustainability industries. Loans are typically secured by first liens on company assets and may include warrants or success fees. This product requires significant financial capital, underwriting expertise, and regulatory compliance as a specialty finance company.

products.name: Equity Investments and Warrants
products.description: Acquisition of equity positions and warrants in portfolio companies, typically as additional consideration for making debt investments. These positions allow participation in the equity appreciation of portfolio companies and are realized through events such as mergers, acquisitions, or IPOs. This product is ancillary to the core lending business and leverages financial structuring and capital markets expertise.

products.name: Managerial Assistance to Portfolio Companies
products.description: Provision of managerial assistance, including operational monitoring, board participation, and organizational or financial guidance, to certain portfolio companies as required under BDC regulations. This service is offered upon request and may generate fees, but is primarily a regulatory requirement and support function for portfolio companies.

products.name: Community Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive suite of banking services including specialized business and personal checking accounts, internet banking, online bill payment, lock box services, remote capture and deposit, cash management, wire transfers, safety deposit boxes, courier services, retail investment services, and ACH originations, delivered through physical banking centers and digital channels.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Traditional and specialized deposit accounts for consumers and businesses, including interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing checking accounts, money market deposit accounts (MMDAs), savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and IRAs, delivered via branch and digital channels.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: A range of commercial loans including commercial real estate mortgages, construction and development loans, working capital loans, business expansion loans, and lines of credit, primarily to small and medium-sized businesses and professionals, underwritten and serviced through local banking centers.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Personal loans to individuals, including auto, boat, and recreational vehicle loans, personal lines of credit, and other major personal, family, or household loans, underwritten based on individual credit quality and delivered through banking centers.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of fixed and variable rate home mortgages for the purchase and refinance of residential properties, offered through community banking centers and underwritten to secondary market or portfolio standards.

products.name: Government Guaranteed Lending
products.description: Origination of government-guaranteed loans, specifically SBA 504 and USDA loans, to businesses (including those in rural areas), with underwriting to federal program standards and delivered through community banking centers.

products.name: Merchant Processing and Treasury Management Services
products.description: Business services including merchant processing, treasury management, ACH originations, lock box services, remote deposit capture, and night depository, delivered via digital and physical channels to business customers.

products.name: Contract Logistics Services
products.description: Comprehensive logistics solutions including material handling, consolidation, sequencing, sub-assembly, cross-dock operations, kitting, repacking, warehousing, returnable container management, and rail lift services, delivered through company-managed facilities and often integrated into customer production environments under long-term contracts.

products.name: Dedicated Transportation Services
products.description: Short-haul or round-trip transportation services within defined geographic areas, provided using a mix of employee drivers, owner-operators, and contract drivers, often as a critical component of customer operations.

products.name: Intermodal Drayage Services
products.description: Local and regional drayage services moving international and domestic containers between ports or railheads and customer facilities, utilizing company-managed terminals, owner-operators, company-owned equipment, and third-party capacity providers.

products.name: Trucking Services
products.description: Transportation of a broad range of commodities (including automotive parts, machinery, building materials, food products, steel, and other goods) via dry van, flatbed, heavy-haul, and refrigerated operations, coordinated through agents and company-managed terminals using owner-operators, company equipment, and brokered capacity.

products.name: Intermodal Terminal Management Services
products.description: Management and operation of intermodal rail terminals, providing time-sensitive terminal and related services to Class I, regional, and short-line railroads across North America, leveraging specialized operating expertise and customer relationships.

products.name: Aerospace Control Systems and Components
products.description: Integrated systems and components for management of fuel, air, combustion, and motion control in commercial and military aircraft, including products such as fuel pumps, metering units, actuators, air valves, specialty valves, fuel nozzles, thrust reverser actuation systems, flight deck controls, servocontrols, motors, and sensors. These are physically manufactured and assembled for OEMs and end users.

products.name: Aerospace Services (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul)
products.description: Maintenance, repair, overhaul (MRO), replacement, and other services for installed aerospace products, delivered through direct service to airlines, military depots, repair shops, and other end users. Services are provided via specialized facilities and skilled labor.

products.name: Industrial Energy Control Systems and Components
products.description: Systems and components for management and control of energy in the form of fuel, air, fluids, gases, motion, combustion, and electricity for industrial applications. Products include actuators, valves, pumps, fuel injection systems, solenoids, ignition systems, control systems, electronics, software, and sensors, physically manufactured and integrated into turbines, engines, compressors, and industrial equipment.

products.name: Industrial Services (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul)
products.description: Maintenance, repair, overhaul, and related services for installed industrial energy control products, delivered through direct service, authorized distributors, and system integrators. Services are provided via specialized facilities and skilled labor.

products.name: Commercial and Retail Banking Services
products.description: Provides a full range of commercial and retail banking products including checking accounts, savings accounts, time deposit accounts, commercial, mortgage and installment loans, home equity loans and lines of credit, safe deposit boxes, money orders, bank checks, automated teller machines, and internet banking. These services are delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and financial capital.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers personal and corporate trust services, including estate settlement, trust administration, employee benefit plans, and retirement services. These services are delivered by specialized professionals and require fiduciary expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: Provides a variety of insurance products through licensed representatives. These products are sold to customers and require regulatory compliance and licensed personnel.

products.name: Offshore Manufactured Products
products.description: Highly engineered, technology-driven products and services for offshore oil and natural gas production systems and facilities, including FlexJoint® technology, connector systems, high-pressure riser systems, managed pressure drilling systems, compact valves, deepwater mooring systems, cranes, subsea pipeline products, and offshore installation, inspection, and repair services. These are physically manufactured and delivered globally, often for deepwater and complex offshore projects.

products.name: Completion and Production Services
products.description: Equipment and services used to establish and maintain the flow of oil and natural gas from wells throughout their life cycle, including pressure control equipment and downhole and extended-reach technologies. products.name: Downhole Technologies
